goal: Genuinely enforce the required Miben kér segítséget? choice for page272-origin Form33 submissions without modifying shared Form33 settings, creating a second validator snippet or changing other pages.

code_snippets_scope_proof.current_ID36: front-end scope; is_page(272) guard inside its footer callback
code_snippets_scope_proof.plugin_execution_source: Code Snippets snippet-ops selects active PHP scopes global, single-use and is_admin() ? admin : front-end.
code_snippets_scope_proof.consequence: A non-admin MetForm REST request can load the existing front-end-scoped ID36 PHP snippet. A future mf_after_validation_check filter can therefore be registered at snippet top level without changing ID36 scope to global.
code_snippets_scope_proof.safety: Keep the existing wp_footer semantic code separately guarded by is_page(272). The server filter itself must use strict Form33 route + referer post-id guards because is_page() is not the REST scope mechanism.

proven_metform_scope.entries_api: Api::post_insert reads wp_get_referer(), converts it with url_to_postid(), and passes that post_id into Action::submit.
proven_metform_scope.validation_hook: Action::submit applies mf_after_validation_check after built-in validation and returns an error when is_valid=false.
proven_metform_scope.page_guard: Future filter resolves the same wp_get_referer() through url_to_postid() and requires integer 272.
proven_metform_scope.route_guard: Require exact/current Form33 entries insert route using the same convention already proven by ID5.
proven_metform_scope.field_guard: Use only the exact live-read service radio mf_input_name; never infer from label text.

recommended_sequence: 1 Deploy/verify the already prepared semantic-only ID36 v003 first when its existing live gates pass; keep ID36 front-end scope unchanged.
2 In a later narrow read, obtain exact #af-form-service widget ID/type/mf_input_name/mf_input_required/options and current ID5 body/priority/state.
3 Generate an ID36 v004 candidate by preserving v003 semantic code byte-for-byte and adding one named top-level mf_after_validation_check callback only.
4 Update existing ID36 only; no second snippet and no scope change.
5 Run the non-delivery direct callback tests, then read back ID36 and unchanged page272/Form33 saved state.

future_filter_contract.callback_name: af_hedge_validate_required_service (name reserved for plan; final code generated only after exact field read)
future_filter_contract.preexisting_failure: If incoming is_valid is already false, return the entire result unchanged so ID5/photo or other validator messages are never overwritten.
future_filter_contract.missing_or_empty_exact_service_field: Return is_valid=false with user-visible message only after the current/native/source error copy has been proven.
future_filter_contract.present_service_field: Return unchanged; do not whitelist guessed values until current six exact option values are read.

mandatory_reads_before_v004_generation: Current page272 accepted baseline/hash and current ID36 v003 or v001 body/state depending actual deployment state.
Current #af-form-service exact MetForm widget settings: widget ID/type, mf_input_name, mf_input_required, six option values/order.
Current ID5 exact body, hook priority/registration style, active state, code_error and route guard.
Current Code Snippets ID36 scope must still be front-end; if scope drifted, stop and reconcile before code generation.
do_not: Do not create a new global validator snippet by default.
Do not change ID36 to global scope merely for REST validation.
Do not modify shared Form33 settings from page272 scope.
Do not guess service field name, values or visible error copy.
Do not call a real MetForm submit route for acceptance in the current no-submission mode.
